title.narrative: Potenziamento e Rafforzamento delle Infrastrutture e dei Servizi Materno-Infantili in Albania - PRISMA
Strengthening and Enhancing Maternal and Child Health Infrastructure and Services in Albania - PRISMA

description.narrative: Il programma MATHERNA (MATERnal and Neonatal Health Advancement in Albania) è composto da due componenti progettuali complementari: PRISMA (Potenziamento e Rafforzamento delle Infrastrutture e dei Servizi Materno-Infantili in Albania), implementato dall'ASST FBFS. PRISMA integra ANMA attraverso la formazione del personale sanitario, il rafforzamento dei sistemi di riferimento e la definizione degli standard per le attrezzature mediche. Inoltre, PRISMA contribuisce allo sviluppo del master plan per la NICU dell’Ospedale Koço Gliozheni, garantendo che gli investimenti infrastrutturali siano allineati a una visione sostenibile a lungo termine. Insieme, questi progetti creano un quadro d’intervento coordinato, in linea con la Strategia Nazionale per la Salute dell’Albania 2021-2030 e con gli Obiettivi di Sviluppo Sostenibile (SDGs 3, 5, 17)e rappresenta un’iniziativa pilota che mira a potenziare le strutture di Tirana e degli ospedali regionali di Fier e Dibër, selezionati in base a tassi di natalità, posizione strategica e iniziative esistenti. Complessivamente, si stima che beneficeranno direttamente dell’intervento circa 70.000 neonati e 63.000 madri in tre anni (fonte: INSTAT 2023 e Shtylla et al. 2018). PRISMA prevede inoltre la formazione specialistica di 150 infermieri/ostetriche e 40 neonatologi/ginecologi, oltre al coinvolgimento di 30 studenti del quarto anno dell’Università di Medicina di Tirana.

The MATHERNA Programme (MATERnal and Neonatal Health Advancement in Albania) consists of two complementary project components: • ANMA (Advancing Neonatal and Maternal Health in Albania), implemented by the Ministry of Health and Social Protection (MoHSP) under Article 7 of Law 125/2014, focuses on infrastructure improvement and the procurement of medical equipment. It includes the rehabilitation of the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at Koço Gliozheni Hospital in Tirana, as well as the acquisition of equipment for the NICUs of Koço Gliozheni, Mbretëresha Geraldina, Fier, and Dibër hospitals. These interventions aim to improve service quality, reduce neonatal and maternal mortality, and limit emergency transfers to Tirana. • PRISMA (Strengthening and Enhancing Maternal and Child Health Infrastructure and Services in Albania), implemented by ASST Fatebenefratelli Sacco (FBFS), complements ANMA through healthcare staff training, reinforcement of referral systems, and the definition of standards for medical equipment. Additionally, PRISMA contributes to the development of the master plan for the NICU at Koço Gliozheni Hospital, ensuring that infrastructure investments are aligned with a sustainable long-term vision. Together, these projects create a coordinated intervention framework, aligned with Albania’s National Health Strategy 2021–2030 and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs 3, 5, 17) and represents a pilot initiative aimed at strengthening the facilities in Tirana and the regional hospitals of Fier and Dibër, selected based on birth rates, strategic location, and existing initiatives. Overall, it is estimated that approximately 70,000 newborns and 63,000 mothers will directly benefit from the intervention over three years (Source: INSTAT 2023 and Shtylla et al. 2018). PRISMA also provides for the specialized training of 150 nurses/midwives and 40 neonatologists/gynecologists, in addition to the involvement of 30 fourth-year students from the University of Medicine in Tirana.
